description: This file defines the CustomField controller class for managing customer custom fields within the OpenCart admin panel. It includes methods for listing, creating, editing, and managing the display of custom fields through web interface actions.

classes.name: CustomField
classes.description: Controller class for handling customer custom field operations such as list display, form handling, and CRUD operations in the admin interface.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry point that initializes the list view of customer custom fields.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles the display of the list of custom fields with data sorting and pagination.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Generates and returns the HTML view for the custom fields list, including sorting, pagination, and actions.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles listing of custom fields; calls getList() to produce content.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form for creating or editing a custom field.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving or updating custom field data submitted from the form.
